limitations: All four scheduled A/B/A/B outcomes are retained; no best-run selection.
Callback intervals are rendering opportunities, not presented FPS or physical-device measurements.
Desktop full windows include a long settle tail. Compare leading twelve intervals as descriptive data, without changing the acceptance gate.
Press-to-release has 23 versus 24 desktop intervals under the same 200 ms hold; median rank changes must not be sold as a rendering speedup.
The observer records down/up but not delivered pointermoves. Exact delivered hold and one-to-one move/frame causality are not reconstructed.
A diagnostic report does not certify final main UI acceptance.
